update.title: Edit watering plan for {date}
update.description: The watering plan can be edited in this view if certain data is no longer accurate or additional information needs to be recorded, for example. A watering plan always requires at least one stop to be visited and at least one staff member to carry out the watering plan. A vehicle must also be assigned.
update.statusEditNotice: A watering plan's status can be edited separately.
update.deletingLabel: The watering plan is being deleted

statusUpdate.title: Edit status of watering plan {date}
statusUpdate.description: A watering plan's status describes whether it is currently being carried out, has been completed, or was canceled, for example. This information helps categorize the watering plans that have been created and build an evaluation. Once a watering plan is completed, you can also specify how each stop was handled.
statusUpdate.finishedNotice: This watering plan is completed. Its status can no longer be changed.
statusUpdate.cancelReasonPlaceholder: Why was the watering plan canceled?
statusUpdate.notCompletedReasonPlaceholder: Why wasn't the watering plan carried out?
statusUpdate.toastSuccess: The watering plan's status was updated successfully.

form.noStartPointsError: No start points are available. A watering plan cannot be created without a start point.
form.transporterTankUsedHint: Clear this if only the trailer carries water. The route then plans with the trailer's capacity alone.
form.driversMultiSelectHint: Hold down the »Shift« key to make a multiple selection.
form.noQualifiedDriverError: No selected staff member has all the required driving licences for the selected vehicles.
form.createLeaveMessage: Do you really want to leave this page? Your entries for creating the watering plan will be lost if you leave now.
form.updateLeaveMessage: Do you really want to leave this page? Your changes to the watering plan will be lost if you leave now.
form.createSuccessMessage: The watering plan was created successfully.
form.updateSuccessMessage: The watering plan was updated successfully.

create.title: Create new watering plan
create.description: A watering plan maps out a route: it can be assigned a vehicle, a trailer, staff, and the stops to visit. A newly created watering plan is automatically classified as "planned". The watering plan's start point can be chosen from the configured depot locations.
